notes: Cortex 2.1.1: agents find much more of what you saved. Fixed a search bug where AI agents only ever searched your 10 most recently changed notes; cortex_start can now take a goal and hands back the memory passages that matter; search results show the passage that answers the query (headings kept exactly); Fetcher's free check tells agents when your notes already cover a topic, so they read instead of paying for research; leaner results cost fewer tokens. Measured with the Train AI benchmark: 2.2x more passes per dollar than 2.1.0.
